WITH v(x) AS
  (VALUES('0'::numeric),('1'),('-1'),('4.2'),('inf'),('-inf'),('nan'))
SELECT x1, x2,
  x1 + x2 AS sum,

  x1 * x2 AS prod

    (0, 0, tiny, 4),
    (tiny, 0, tiny, 4),

    (1, 1, 0, 2147483647)
